relationships.subject: grapiprant
relationships.evidence_quote: Grapiprant binds to human and rat EP4 receptors with high affinity

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2 binds to EP receptors with subsequent activation of intracellular signalling pathways resulting in an increase in intracellular cAMP and thus activation of protein kinases.

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: The latter leads to phosphorylation of a number of target proteins including TRPV1 channels, voltage‐gated Na+ or T‐type calcium channels which contribute to sensitization mechanisms in the peripheral nervous system

relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2 is a typical inflammatory mediator released after induction of COX‐2 in injured tissue and cells

key_findings: Grapiprant is a selective EP4 antagonist approved for canine OA pain; clinical efficacy only modestly better than placebo and inferior to NSAIDs in acute models
